title: C++: Plugin System (Simulated)
description: Simulate a plugin system where plugins register operations via a callback registry.

steps.title: Plugin Registry
steps.description: Create a Plugin struct with name and execute function. Create a Registry class that stores plugins. Implement registerPlugin and runPlugin. Create two plugins: 'math' (prints 5+3=8) and 'greet' (prints 'Hello!').
hints: struct Plugin { string name; function<void()> execute; };
runPlugin: find by name and call execute.

verification.test: output.includes('8') && output.includes('Hello from plugin') && output.includes('not found')
verification.failureMessage: Run plugins: math, greet, and unknown
